**Roman Cortez** is a former [Mattel](/wiki/Mattel) employee who worked with [Hot Wheels](/wiki/Hot_Wheels) from [2003](/wiki/2003) to [2013](/wiki/2013) as a project designer and from 2013 to [2015](/wiki/2015) as a Senior Marketing Director. Cortez specializes in graphics design and is noted for his "cartoonish, graffiti style". He is currently a VP of brand and product development at Plastic Meatball and a creative director at [Kaido House](/wiki/Jun_Imai).
